name: Haruka Shimazu
source:
Rei’s sister and a dedicated journalist at The Shibuya Times, one of Japan’s most influential news outlets. Haruka possesses an unwavering determination that draws others to her, her calm and perceptive nature concealing a tenacity few can match.

She has an instinct for uncovering truths that others overlook, and her devotion to protecting Rei often places her in the shadows of danger she faces with quiet resolve. Behind her composed exterior lies a fierce heart, one willing to challenge powerful forces to shield those she loves. Haruka’s presence is both grounding and compelling, a steady force in the whirlwind of Rei’s life.
